newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson says to set up China R&D centre.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson says to set up China R&D centre.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group Ericsson said on Thursday that it will set up a research and development (R&D) centre in Shanghai, China.
The new R&D centre will develop telecommunications and data communications products for both the Chinese and global markets, Ericssons said in a statement.
"The initial focus will be on the development of software products for access networks," the company said.

President of Ericsson China, Olof Lenneman, said China is now the second largest market for Ericsson and the new centre highlighted Ericsson's commitment to transferring technology and know-how to China on a long term basis.
The centre, which will eventually employ 100 Chinese engineers, is expected to be operational in the third quarter of 1997.
